title: The Derma Co 2% Niacinamide Oily Skin Cleanser
shortDescription: A true savior for all the sensitive skin fam out there!
description:
A true savior for all the sensitive skin fam out there! The Derma Co. 2% Niacinamide Oily Skin Cleanser is a blend of non-irritating, gel-based formulation that is 100% soap-free. With its gentle foaming, it removes excess facial oiliness & gently cleanses pores without damaging the skin barrier. Enriched with 2% Niacinamide, Cica-Extract & Salicylic Acid, this cleanser effectively soothes sensitive skin, protects skin’s barrier & keeps it hydrated & soft. It shields your skin from environmental stressors & gently removes dirt, impurities & even makeup! The best part - this derma-approved cleanser retains skin’s moisture, ensuring optimal hydration for 24 hours post wash - making it a win-win for your skin!

As part of dermatological safety evaluation, The Derma Co. 2% Niacinamide Oily Skin Cleanser for Sensitive, Oily & Combination Skin was assessed through Primary Skin Irritation Testing and found Dermatologically Safe for use and Non-Irritant under protocol no. C3B03444 .
highlights: Key actives: Niacinamide, Salicylic Acid, Cica
